description: Ministry of Highways and Investment Promotion - Order to designate the Kottawa - Kadawatha Section of Outer Circular National Highway as an Expressway District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of regulatory powers under the National Thoroughfares Act, No. 40 of 2008. It contains a legal order designating a specific highway section as an expressway and rescinding a previous order, which constitutes regulatory action under existing legislation. While it mentions Minister Kabir Hashim, it does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his ministerial title, and the core content focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
